bio: The culinary concept behind 100 Maneiras is one of absolute freedom – one that constantly takes risks and seeks to provoke a strong reaction and to leave a lasting mark with guests, often via ingredients referred to as from the future or that are little known (the larvae with onions was a dish that definitely came as a surprise!).Everything here revolves around chef Ljubomir Stanisic, a native of Sarajevo (Bosnia-Herzegovina), who arrived in Portugal in his late-teens following the war in his country, healing the wounds of his soul by devoting himself to cooking.
